meta.description: Bone lengths measured from the redrawn side-view character art (assets/images/nova/mannequins/sideView.png), for use with gait_angles.json.
meta.method: Each length is the straight-line distance between two art pivots (the pivots block of rig_config.json, positions in the 800x800 art frame). The rig recomputes these from the pivots at load, so the two files stay in step as long as both are updated together.
meta.symmetry: Left and right bones are identical. One value is stored per bone.
meta.notes: Measured 2026-11-11 from the redesigned mannequin sheet. Hip and shoulder are the centres of the rounded tops of the thigh and upper arm; elbow, wrist, rib (waist), knee and ankle are the centres of the overlap between neighbouring parts; neck is the top centre of the chest piece. neckToChest = neck to rib, chestToPelvis = rib to hip, shoulderToNeck = shoulder to neck.

referenceJoints.note: Side-view joint centres of the standing art, in px in the 800x800 frame (same numbers as rig_config.json pivots).
